mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between UNRATE decreases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real estate sales (HOUST) signals a strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within the last month signals a strong supply-side response, which boosts economic output and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% each within the last quarter signals a strong demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and RSAFS both increase > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint correlation between GDPC1, RSAFS increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% within the last month signals an inflationary environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the joint correlation between FEDFUNDS decreases, CPIAUCSL increases and positive SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within the last month signals a weakening supply-side response, which reduces economic output and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the correlation between INDPRO decreases and negative SPX returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
